Q2 fills in gap G005: whether minimum production or sales requirements exist, which would add lower-bound or fulfillment constraints. Q3 fills in hard_soft_policy gap G006: whether grain, meat, and Meaties capacity limits are hard constraints or can be exceeded at extra cost, which changes the model from a pure LP with fixed capacities to one with penalty/expansion decisions. All three are business-structure questions rather than merely mathematical ones, and all are answerable by a business user. Q3 is the most important first question because it determines whether the core capacity and raw-material limits are fixed constraints or decision variables with costs; this is a fundamental hard-versus-soft policy that would otherwise be silently assumed as hard by default. Q1 and Q2 are also valuable, but Q3 most strongly affects the objective, constraints, and decision scope of the resulting OR model.
